Verify Now Blog > PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - AI Pyramid Computing Box Pro 8GB Version PCBWay Store NewArrival Product - AI Pyramid Computing Box Pro 8GB Version by: PCBWay Nov 23,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCBWay Store Link： AI Pyramid Computing Box AI Pyramid-Pro is a pyramid-shaped high-performance AI PC purpose-built for local AI inference and edge intelligence deployments. Powered by the Axera AX8850 SoC, it integrates an octa-core Cortex-A55 processor and a 24 TOPS @ INT8 NPU to effortlessly handle complex workloads including visual recognition, multimodal interaction, and on-device large language model inference. AI Pyramid-Pro features 8GB LPDDR4x high-bandwidth memory paired with a dedicated hardware video processing engine, supporting 8K H.264/H.265 encode/decode and 16-channel 1080p parallel decoding to satisfy AI vision analytics, video processing, and multi-stream media application demands. Equipped with dual HDMI 2.0 interfaces (1× input + 1× output), dual Gigabit Ethernet, USB 3.0, and USB Type-C ports, it offers exceptional flexibility for display output, networking, and peripheral expansion. It functions as a desktop-grade AI computing platform and is optimized for edge computing field deployments. Catering to AI PCs, edge intelligent terminals, and interactive smart devices, AI Pyramid-Pro delivers consistent AI inference performance for localized AI systems such as AI vision gateways, smart security, and local intelligent photo albums (Immich).
